name: viewer
description: Viewer-only service navigation, DMZ publication, catalog-based HTTP/WebSocket routing and browser namespace compatibility. Contracts: spec/feature/unified-viewer.md and spec/feature/viewer-dmz.md.
rationale: The Viewer domain owns manifest publication, the isolated DMZ worker and bundle, catalog-gated browser embedding, and its HTTP, WebSocket, URL-rewrite, storage, and cookie boundaries.
